description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the FormatWithLocationId class, which is part of the OrangeHRM Maintenance plugin's AccessStrategy formatting module. The test verifies that getFormattedValue returns expected results given certain input, using test data populated from a YAML fixture.

classes.name: FormatWithLocationIdTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for the FormatWithLocationId class, verifying formatting behavior for location IDs.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures, loads test data, and instantiates the class under test.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Asserts that the getFormattedValue method correctly formats location IDs, returning 'location 1' for ID 1 and null for ID 5.
